repository.name: Pagelet
repository.description: Your website. Your products. Your start.

milestones.title: M1 · Foundation
milestones.description: Prove deployment/runtime/database constraints and establish repeatable infrastructure. Operational foundation stories may finish alongside core development.

milestones.title: M2 · Core product
milestones.description: Deliver the owner publishing and customer purchase-to-learning flows.

milestones.title: M3 · Launch
milestones.description: Verify security, accessibility, recovery and a clean owner installation before v1.

milestones.title: M4 · Enhancements
milestones.description: Optional post-v1 learning and sales improvements; not required to ship the core product.

epics.title: Foundation and Azure feasibility
epics.outcome: Prove the low-cost architecture and establish a reproducible development workflow.

issues.title: Prove SWA managed Functions and PostgreSQL on Azure
issues.outcome: Resolve hosting constraints before building commerce.
acceptance: Deploy a disposable static frontend and Node.js 22 managed HTTP Function with /api routing; record exact runtime/configuration.
Prove pooled PostgreSQL TLS connectivity, cold-start behavior, cookie round trips, raw webhook request bytes, and the owner identity boundary.
Record limits for 45-second HTTP requests, lack of managed identity/private networking/timers, and required credential rotation.
Compare Neon and Azure PostgreSQL with a dated cost/network decision; document cleanup and reject unsupported architecture assumptions.
issues.verification: Attach Azure smoke results and a decision record; no production purchase or private data.

issues.title: Scaffold the static web app, HTTP API, and local environment
issues.outcome: Make a fresh checkout runnable with one documented workflow.
acceptance: Create apps/web (React/TypeScript/Vite), api (TypeScript Functions), shared contracts, db, infra, and test folders with pinned supported dependencies.
Configure SWA navigation, /api errors, local auth emulation, and node:22 consistently; unknown API paths never return index.html.
Provide a PostgreSQL local setup, dummy fixtures, environment examples, and ignored local secrets.
Add lint, typecheck, build and focused test scripts; production does not contain the design prototype or dev-auth bypass.
issues.verification: Fresh clone install/build and local SWA health request succeed; API 404 and private-route handling verified.

issues.title: Create PostgreSQL schema and migration workflow
issues.outcome: Protect orders and ownership with relational constraints.
acceptance: Implement the core entities and invariants in ARCHITECTURE.md, including effective entitlements and separate purchase grants.
Use unique provider IDs, foreign keys, integer money, UTC instants, and unique customer/lesson progress.
Provide versioned SQL migrations, migration locking, separate migration/runtime roles, and development seed data.
Demonstrate upgrade from an earlier schema and safe backup/restore recovery; app requests never migrate implicitly.
issues.verification: Run integration checks against real PostgreSQL for uniqueness, rollback, foreign keys, and migration concurrency.

issues.title: Establish CI checks and API conventions
issues.outcome: Keep changes buildable and errors consistent.
acceptance: CI runs install from lockfile, lint, typecheck, frontend/API builds and relevant tests with least-privilege permissions and pinned actions.
Define structured validation errors, request IDs, redacted logs, bounded request bodies, pagination, and public/private cache behavior.
Use safe PR checks without production secrets; publish only sanitized test artifacts.
Document checks required for merge and how to reproduce them locally.
issues.verification: A deliberate validation failure returns the agreed contract; CI passes on the scaffold and fails for a broken build.

epics.title: Owner identity and customer access
epics.outcome: Give one owner control and customers secure access to their purchases.

issues.title: Enforce exactly one configured owner
issues.outcome: Prevent another authenticated identity from administering the shop.
acceptance: Configure one SWA provider plus immutable owner ID outside the public bundle; no first-login claiming, invitations, or role editor.
Check the exact owner identity on every admin API and guard admin routes; fail closed when configuration is missing.
Provide logout, expired-session behavior, and a trusted configuration-based owner recovery guide.
Ensure production ignores dev identity headers and customer sessions never imply owner privileges.
issues.verification: Test anonymous/customer/wrong-provider/wrong-ID denial and configured-owner success through deployed SWA.

issues.title: Implement passwordless customer sign-in and recovery
issues.outcome: Let buyers recover their purchases through verified email.
acceptance: Issue random single-use expiring login tokens, store only hashes, and rate-limit by normalized identity and request source without revealing account existence.
Use an explicit confirmation POST before consuming the token so mail scanners cannot log in or burn links.
Create rotating server-side sessions with Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookies, logout/revoke paths, and CSRF/origin checks.
Constrain return URLs to local allowed paths; mask addresses in UI and redact tokens from logs.
issues.verification: Verify expiry/replay, enumeration resistance, scanner GET, cross-origin mutation, session rotation and email recovery.

issues.title: Centralize customer entitlement checks
issues.outcome: Ensure every paid asset and lesson belongs to the signed-in buyer.
acceptance: Authorize library, lesson, progress, asset and receipt access by customer and effective entitlement.
Resolve course/resource relationships server-side; guessing another object ID never grants access.
Published previews expose only explicitly public content; draft previews require owner access.
Define no-store responses and access-denied/expired-session states without leaking purchase details.
issues.verification: Integration tests cross two customers, revoked/absent grants, draft products and mismatched resource IDs.

issues.title: Add transactional access email and delivery recovery
issues.outcome: Make purchase access reliable without a background scheduler.
acceptance: Create templates for login links, purchase access and refund/access changes with accessible text/HTML variants.
Persist outbox entries in the relevant transaction; bound synchronous delivery time and use provider idempotency where available.
Expose failed/pending deliveries to the owner with audited retry; customer login recovery works even if the purchase email failed.
Document provider setup, sender-domain verification, retry semantics and the HTTP-only scheduler tradeoff.
issues.verification: Simulate transport timeout, duplicate retry and DB commit failure; no lost order or duplicate entitlement.

epics.title: Product and course authoring
epics.outcome: Let the owner create and safely publish useful learning products.

issues.title: Build the product catalog model and editor
issues.outcome: Create courses and standalone digital products.
acceptance: Edit title, slug, description, outcomes, cover, price/currency and product type with shared validation.
Support draft/published/archived lifecycle; sold products archive instead of destructive deletion.
Preserve purchase snapshots when prices or titles change, and prevent concurrent edits from silently overwriting each other.
Provide explicit save, unsaved-change warning, empty catalog and actionable validation errors.
issues.verification: Create/edit/archive both product types; verify slug collisions, stale saves and unchanged historical orders.

issues.title: Build the curriculum and lesson editor
issues.outcome: Organize course content without a complex CMS.
acceptance: Create ordered sections and video/text lessons, attach resources, and set preview visibility explicitly.
Provide accessible move-up/down actions alongside optional drag reorder; order survives reload.
Sanitize rich text and restrict embeds/URLs; prevent orphan or cross-product resources.
Validate required media/transcripts and show draft preview only to the owner.
issues.verification: Exercise editing/reordering with keyboard and malicious content fixtures; verify draft privacy.

issues.title: Build the digital-download product editor
issues.outcome: Sell files independently of a course.
acceptance: Attach one or several validated PDF/EPUB/ZIP/MP3/image assets with version labels and clear included-file details.
Configure update availability for existing buyers; replacing a file does not break historical purchase access.
Prevent deleting referenced paid assets and prohibit public object URLs.
Provide publish-readiness errors for missing/rejected files and clear upload progress/retry states.
issues.verification: Publish a PDF and ZIP product; replace a file and confirm an existing buyer still has the promised access.

issues.title: Implement draft preview and atomic publication
issues.outcome: Separate saved edits from a working public listing.
acceptance: Create a publishable catalog version and validate required content, price, legal settings and assets before publication.
Expose owner-only preview; trigger the static public catalog build via a narrowly scoped server credential.
Show publishing/succeeded/failed state, retain last successful public version on failure, and allow retry without duplication.
Handle unpublish/archive policy explicitly: existing entitled customers retain promised content unless revoked.
issues.verification: Force build failure and retry; verify public HTML never includes drafts, private lessons or secrets.

issues.title: Add shop branding, creator profile and legal settings
issues.outcome: Make the installation feel like the creator’s own shop.
acceptance: Edit shop name, logo, accessible accent, introduction, creator biography, contact links and featured product.
Validate accent contrast and image alternatives; retain a usable default theme.
Configure one currency, timezone, seller details, refund/privacy/terms pages and required digital-delivery consent.
Block live checkout when required seller/legal/tax choices are incomplete; store policy version with orders.
issues.verification: Preview mobile/desktop branding; reject inaccessible color and incomplete launch configuration.

epics.title: Private files and video delivery
epics.outcome: Deliver large media without routing bytes through managed Functions.

issues.title: Implement owner-only direct uploads
issues.outcome: Keep uploads private, bounded and recoverable.
acceptance: Create private containers and blob-specific short-lived write URLs after owner validation and quota checks.
Upload browser-to-storage with progress/cancel/retry; never send media through SWA APIs.
Finalize against expected object key, actual size and type; keep assets quarantined until validation succeeds.
Reject active/executable types, avoid extracting ZIPs, and define cleanup for aborted/rejected uploads plus credential rotation.
issues.verification: Upload beyond API size/duration thresholds directly; test forged finalization, over-limit objects and expired SAS.

issues.title: Implement authorized file delivery and versioning
issues.outcome: Only an entitled buyer can mint a download link.
acceptance: Issue read-only blob-specific links after relationship and entitlement checks, with a five-minute default expiry.
Use safe download filenames/content disposition and private/no-store API responses; log no SAS queries.
Preserve asset versions required by purchases and define audited retention/orphan cleanup.
Display expired/missing/revoked-file states; state that previously downloaded files cannot be recalled.
issues.verification: Test another customer, revoked grants, expired links, filename injection and inaccessible raw storage URLs.

issues.title: Deliver protected video with captions and resume
issues.outcome: Make pre-encoded lessons watchable on real devices.
acceptance: Support MP4 H.264/AAC direct playback with Range requests, WebVTT captions and transcript access.
Mint bounded playback URLs and refresh only after rechecking entitlement; preserve position during refresh.
Handle buffering, unsupported media, missing captions, network failure and session expiry without autoplay.
Document encoding guidance, upload limits, lack of adaptive transcoding/DRM, and measured bandwidth.
issues.verification: Verify seek/resume, expiry mid-play, revoked refresh, captions and mobile Safari/Chromium playback.

issues.title: Expose media quotas and safe lifecycle maintenance
issues.outcome: Make storage growth visible to the owner.
acceptance: Display validated stored bytes, configured upload limits, failed uploads and unused asset candidates.
Require explicit confirmation before recoverable cleanup; never delete assets referenced by live purchase promises.
Provide audit records and documented storage lifecycle/version retention rules.
Evaluate scanning of owner uploads and document trust/cost choice; no unreviewed public upload path.
issues.verification: Run cleanup on fixtures containing sold, draft, orphan and failed assets; prove sold references survive.

epics.title: Distinctive storefront and design system
epics.outcome: Give creators a polished, fast, accessible shop with a recognizable visual identity.

issues.title: Implement the Pagelet design system and app shells
issues.outcome: Turn the digital bookshelf direction into reusable UI.
acceptance: Implement DESIGN.md tokens, self-hosted licensed fonts, buttons, fields, tabs, dialogs, notices and layout primitives.
Build Shop, My learning and Studio shells with clear navigation and responsive behavior at 360/768/1440px.
Include focus, hover, disabled, pending, success, empty and error states; respect reduced motion.
Use the prototype as a visual reference while replacing its fictional behavior with typed production components.
issues.verification: Provide desktop/mobile screenshots, keyboard walkthrough and automated accessibility results.

issues.title: Build the public catalog and static product export
issues.outcome: Make public products discoverable and crawlable.
acceptance: Render featured course, product collection, type filters, price/currency and clear empty/no-results states.
Generate only published public pages and metadata from a versioned catalog export; no paid content in assets or HTML.
Create canonical URLs, sitemap/robots rules, Open Graph data and appropriate structured data.
Use real 404 behavior, stable slugs/redirects, optimized covers and small lazy-loaded bundles.
issues.verification: Inspect generated HTML without JavaScript; verify draft exclusion, filter keyboard behavior, missing slugs and sitemap.

issues.title: Build course and download product detail pages
issues.outcome: Let visitors understand what they are buying.
acceptance: Show outcomes, creator, prerequisites, included assets or curriculum, price/currency and refund terms.
Expose only explicitly public previews; list locked lessons without private URLs.
Use one clear purchase/open action with pending/error handling and known-purchase behavior.
Lay out long titles, empty optional sections and mobile purchase controls without obscuring content.
issues.verification: Test course/download variants, preview authorization, long content and responsive accessibility.

issues.title: Build checkout return and access-recovery screens
issues.outcome: Help buyers recover from slow payments or lost email.
acceptance: Handle pending, paid, failed, canceled and expired checkout states without granting client-side access.
Provide a verified-email access route and helpful masked-address guidance; never show another buyer’s order.
Use bounded polling with retry/backoff and a stable recovery path when a webhook is delayed.
Display receipts/policies and distinguish a payment still processing from a purchase ready to open.
issues.verification: Simulate closing the browser after payment, delayed webhook, wrong customer and email delivery failure.

issues.title: Review and polish all responsive customer and owner flows
issues.outcome: Meet the intended visual standard across full journeys.
acceptance: Review catalog, details, checkout handoff, library, player, editor, orders and settings against DESIGN.md.
Fix content hierarchy, spacing, wrapping, dialog focus, touch targets and 200% zoom behavior.
Provide deliberate empty/loading/error/expired/revoked states with consistent action wording.
Capture reviewed desktop/mobile screenshots and document any justified visual changes.
issues.verification: Manual keyboard and screen-reader spot checks plus visual regression evidence for critical screens.

epics.title: Payments and reliable fulfillment
epics.outcome: Turn verified payments into correct, auditable customer access.

issues.title: Create server-priced Stripe Checkout sessions
issues.outcome: Accept payment without handling card data.
acceptance: Create one-product Checkout Sessions using a published server-side price, integer minor units and configured currency.
Persist the immutable item snapshot and request idempotency key; reject tampered amounts or unpublished products.
Separate test/live mode and validate shop launch settings before live checkout.
Collect required billing/consent information and explain the chosen tax mode; support safe cancel/return URLs.
issues.verification: Sandbox checkout tests cover double click, altered price/currency/product and missing legal configuration.

issues.title: Implement signed idempotent payment fulfillment
issues.outcome: Grant purchases exactly once even when callbacks repeat.
acceptance: Verify Stripe signatures against raw bytes and check event mode plus authoritative paid status.
Process immediate and delayed success/failure events; never treat a redirect or unpaid completed session as payment.
Transactionally record unique event/order identifiers, item snapshot, purchase grant and outbox entry.
Tolerate duplicate/concurrent/out-of-order events; retry transient failures and expose reconciliation status.
issues.verification: Replay sandbox fixtures concurrently; simulate DB rollback, lost redirect and delayed payment; assert one order/grant.

issues.title: Synchronize refunds and disputes with access
issues.outcome: Keep access aligned with the actual purchase state.
acceptance: Sync full/partial refunds and dispute transitions from signed authoritative provider data.
Full refunds revoke their purchase grant; partial refunds retain it by default with explicit owner override.
Open disputes suspend the associated grant; won/lost resolution restores/revokes appropriately without undoing unrelated grants.
Handle events before/after payment completion and audit changes; expose external Stripe action links to the owner.
issues.verification: Test refund-before-paid, duplicate refund, partial refund, dispute win/loss and multiple grants for one product.

issues.title: Implement verified free-product claims
issues.outcome: Offer free resources without an insecure checkout shortcut.
acceptance: Only published zero-price products use the free claim path; paid products cannot be forced to zero by the client.
Require verified customer identity and create an idempotent free grant with an audit record.
Rate-limit abuse and use the same library/delivery authorization as paid purchases.
Do not create a paid Stripe order or automatically subscribe the customer to marketing.
issues.verification: Verify duplicate claims, anonymous attempts, price tampering and legitimate library delivery.

issues.title: Implement receipts and payment reconciliation
issues.outcome: Give the owner a trustworthy recovery path for payment exceptions.
acceptance: Show customer-owned immutable order details and provider receipt links with currency and refund state.
Provide owner-triggered reconciliation by date/provider identifier with bounded batches and idempotent repairs.
Link fulfillment/email exceptions to recovery actions without exposing card data or secrets.
Document reconciliation after downtime and retention requirements for financial records.
issues.verification: Seed missed/duplicate/out-of-order provider events; reconcile twice and verify identical final state.

epics.title: Customer library and learning experience
epics.outcome: Make purchased knowledge pleasant to use and easy to resume.

issues.title: Build the customer purchase library
issues.outcome: Put all available courses and files in one clear place.
acceptance: List only the signed-in customer’s entitled products with course/download differentiation and valid next actions.
Show useful empty, loading, expired-session and revoked-access states; link to purchase recovery.
Paginate large libraries and retain access promised for archived products.
Show purchase/receipt details without revealing personal data to another session.
issues.verification: Two-customer end-to-end library tests including archive, revocation and email recovery.

issues.title: Build the lesson workspace and curriculum navigation
issues.outcome: Let learners focus on the material.
acceptance: Implement responsive curriculum, selected lesson, video/text content, transcript and resources using DESIGN.md.
Support keyboard navigation and a mobile curriculum disclosure with correct focus behavior.
Previews and locked/revoked lessons have distinct states; lesson URLs are deep-linkable after authentication.
Include clear previous/next actions and empty/missing-media recovery.
issues.verification: Navigate a mixed-content course on mobile/desktop with keyboard and screen reader; test unauthorized deep links.

issues.title: Persist progress and safe video resume
issues.outcome: Let customers continue learning across sessions.
acceptance: Persist bounded playback positions and explicit completion with unique customer/lesson records.
Debounce writes, flush appropriately and avoid counting seek events as completion.
Show saved/unsaved/retry state honestly; define conflict handling for two tabs/devices.
Compute progress against eligible published lessons and define how course edits affect completion.
issues.verification: Reload/resume, concurrent updates, offline retry, invalid positions and cross-customer mutations are tested.

issues.title: Build downloads and customer account controls
issues.outcome: Keep access and privacy actions understandable.
acceptance: Show included files, version/format/size, short-lived download action and expired-link retry.
Provide logout, session revocation, receipt access, contact/help and an account-data request path.
Reverify identity for sensitive changes; no uncontrolled email reassignment of purchases.
Explain revoked access and preserve required financial records under a documented retention policy.
issues.verification: Test file download authorization, logout invalidation, stale link retry and customer-owned data boundaries.

epics.title: Single-owner shop operations
epics.outcome: Give one owner the controls needed to run a real shop.

issues.title: Build the owner overview and product workspace
issues.outcome: Make publishing and exceptions the primary admin tasks.
acceptance: Show real sales/refund totals with defined date/currency semantics, recent orders and failed fulfillment/email indicators.
Provide product rows with draft/live/archive status and clear edit/preview/publish actions.
Use a useful first-product empty state; never show fabricated production metrics.
Ensure keyboard, mobile table alternatives and error recovery match the design system.
issues.verification: Reconcile displayed metrics to seeded order/refund records and test empty/large datasets.

issues.title: Build order and customer support views
issues.outcome: Answer common buyer questions without a CRM.
acceptance: Search/paginate orders by safe identifiers and show status, immutable items, receipts and grant history.
Provide a minimal customer purchase view with only necessary personal data.
Expose resend access instructions and external Stripe payment/refund links with audit records.
Provide safe CSV export with formula-injection protection and explicit date/currency columns.
issues.verification: Test pagination, search authorization, dangerous CSV cell values and resend failure recovery.

issues.title: Add complimentary access and revocation controls
issues.outcome: Let the owner resolve access cases transparently.
acceptance: Grant or revoke access for a verified customer/product with a required reason and immutable audit entry.
Preserve distinct purchase and complimentary grant sources; one revocation cannot erase unrelated valid grants.
Explain the effect before confirming and show the updated customer access state.
Send access-change notification through the outbox without making email success a transaction requirement.
issues.verification: Exercise multiple grants, duplicate action, concurrent refund and failed notification; verify effective entitlement.

issues.title: Define privacy, retention and operational audit controls
issues.outcome: Keep customer data proportional to the shop’s needs.
acceptance: Document data inventory, purposes, retention and service-provider locations without claiming automatic legal compliance.
Implement verified export/deletion requests while preserving legally required financial records under configured policy.
Redact tokens, signed URLs and sensitive fields from logs; define audit retention/access.
Add minimal first-party aggregate analytics; optional nonessential tracking requires a deliberate consent design.
issues.verification: Verify export isolation and deletion behavior with linked purchases; inspect logs for seeded sensitive values.

epics.title: Deployment, cost controls and recovery
epics.outcome: Make an installation reproducible, observable and recoverable.

issues.title: Define SWA and private storage infrastructure
issues.outcome: Provision the minimum Azure footprint reproducibly.
acceptance: Create parameterized Bicep for SWA plan/region and private storage with approved origins and secure transport.
Document external PostgreSQL and email prerequisites plus app-setting secret injection/rotation.
Define isolated test/production resources and retention; PR previews must not reach live orders or payment secrets.
Provide deployment outputs, cleanup instructions and a reviewed cost estimate before creating live resources.
issues.verification: Validate templates and deploy a disposable environment; confirm storage anonymity fails and secrets stay out of output.

issues.title: Automate build, migration and SWA deployment
issues.outcome: Ship changes with a safe recovery path.
acceptance: Add GitHub Actions for static build and managed API deployment using least privileges and pinned actions.
Use protected production configuration and separate sandbox integration values; no untrusted fork gets deployment secrets.
Run migrations in a controlled locked step with backward-compatible rollout rules and smoke checks.
Document rollback to a known build and forward repair/restore strategy for nonreversible data migrations.
issues.verification: Deploy a preview, promote a tested build, simulate failed migration and rehearse rollback without touching live orders.

issues.title: Add health, cost and exception observability
issues.outcome: Detect failures without running a large monitoring stack.
acceptance: Emit redacted structured diagnostics, request IDs and health checks that expose no secrets.
Track payment failures, unresolved outbox items, storage growth, API latency and database connection pressure.
Complete COSTS.md worksheet with dated regional rates and pilot/growth measurements; configure budget alerts and bounded retention.
Provide an owner runbook for payment outage, email failure, quota exhaustion and database unavailability.
issues.verification: Inject representative faults and confirm visible signals; calculate video transfer from measured sample playback.

issues.title: Implement backups and rehearse restoration
issues.outcome: Recover purchases and content after data loss.
acceptance: Configure database backup/history and blob version/retention strategy within the chosen provider budget.
Restore into an isolated environment and verify product, order, grant and asset references.
Measure proposed 24h RPO/4h RTO, document actual achieved targets and reconcile Stripe changes after the restore point.
Document credential rotation, backup encryption/access and an upgrade/restore checklist.
issues.verification: Attach a timed restore report and reconciliation results using sandbox data; do not claim untested recovery targets.

epics.title: Launch verification and owner onboarding
epics.outcome: Deliver a tested product that an independent owner can install and run.

issues.title: Verify purchase-to-learning and refund journeys end to end
issues.outcome: Prove the product’s critical business flow.
acceptance: Automate owner publish, customer checkout, webhook fulfillment, email recovery, library, lesson progress and file download.
Cover duplicate/out-of-order events, delayed payment, full/partial refund, disputes, revoked access and missing email.
Run core tests against real PostgreSQL and deployed SWA with Stripe sandbox fixtures.
Keep fixtures isolated and report failures with redacted evidence rather than retrying them into a false pass.
issues.verification: Publish end-to-end results for Chromium plus representative mobile Safari coverage.

issues.title: Audit accessibility, security and performance
issues.outcome: Close release-blocking risks across real user journeys.
acceptance: Test keyboard, screen-reader flows, 200% zoom, captions, focus recovery and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast/semantics.
Exercise owner impersonation, cross-customer access, CSRF, XSS, token replay, rate-limit abuse and private cache leakage.
Measure public JS/LCP/CLS budgets, cold/warm APIs, pooled DB load and video expiry on the actual deployment.
Triage findings with reproduction/evidence; no unresolved critical payment, access or secret-exposure issue at release.
issues.verification: Attach measured reports and verified fixes, including dependency/secret scanning and manual checks.

issues.title: Write and test the installation and operations guide
issues.outcome: Allow a new owner to launch without tribal knowledge.
acceptance: Document account prerequisites, region/cost choices, database/storage/email/Stripe setup and immutable owner configuration.
Walk through branding, legal/tax decisions, first course/download, sandbox purchase and customer recovery.
Include backups, upgrades, rollback, monitoring, billing limits, domain/TLS and troubleshooting.
Run the guide from a clean environment and record gaps; separate sandbox steps from enabling live payments.
issues.verification: A clean-install rehearsal reaches a sandbox course purchase and restore exercise without undocumented steps.

issues.title: Complete the v1 release checklist and live-readiness review
issues.outcome: Ship only when core flows and operational choices are proven.
acceptance: Confirm all M1/M2 stories and other M3 release gates are complete with evidence.
Record chosen costs, restore results, policy/tax configuration, payment/email domains, support path and dependency versions.
Create versioned release notes and upgrade instructions; mark known limitations including MP4 delivery and manual email retry.
Enable live payments only through the owner’s configured deployment process after sandbox verification.
issues.verification: Review the checklist against PRODUCT.md and verify the published release artifact and smoke tests.

epics.title: Focused learning and sales enhancements
epics.outcome: Add the most useful Teachable-inspired capabilities after the core shop works.

issues.title: Add coupons with enforceable limits
issues.outcome: Offer discounts without breaking price integrity.
acceptance: Create fixed/percentage discounts with validity, product scope and maximum redemptions.
Validate server-side and define reservation/release behavior for concurrent or abandoned checkouts.
Preserve discounted totals in order snapshots and display final price before redirect.
Support expiry, zero-floor validation and an accessible invalid-coupon state.
issues.verification: Test concurrent last-use redemption, expiry, wrong product and refund accounting.

issues.title: Add fixed-price course and download bundles
issues.outcome: Sell a curated set with predictable access.
acceptance: Publish bundles of existing products with a single configured price and clear included items.
Snapshot membership at purchase; later edits do not silently remove previously promised access.
Grant constituent products atomically and define full/partial-refund grant policy.
Handle already-owned items clearly without revoking independent grants.
issues.verification: Test bundle edit after purchase, duplicate webhook, partial failure and overlapping individual ownership.

issues.title: Add simple lesson quizzes
issues.outcome: Give learners a useful comprehension check.
acceptance: Support single-choice questions, correct answers and feedback in the owner editor.
Grade on the server, preserve question/version history for attempts and define retake behavior.
Keep answers out of pre-submission payloads when grading matters; require course entitlement.
Provide accessible error/result states without timers or complex exam surveillance.
issues.verification: Test keyboard/screen-reader completion, unauthorized access, version edits and repeat attempts.

issues.title: Add verifiable completion certificates
issues.outcome: Recognize completion without exposing learner data publicly.
acceptance: Define eligibility from versioned completion rules and optional quiz threshold.
Generate an accessible printable certificate/download with unique ID and owner branding.
Offer a minimal opt-in verification view and revocation behavior without public email disclosure.
Make duplicate generation idempotent and preserve certificate version history.
issues.verification: Test eligibility boundaries, duplicate issue, revoked access and minimal public verification data.

issues.title: Add timezone-aware drip lessons
issues.outcome: Release course material gradually without a scheduler.
acceptance: Configure fixed-date or enrollment-relative lesson availability with explicit shop timezone semantics.
Compute eligibility on each server request; do not rely on browser time or timer Functions.
Protect player/resource URLs before unlock and show the learner the next availability time.
Define DST, time-zone changes, complimentary enrollment and refund/regrant behavior; email reminders remain out of scope.
issues.verification: Test DST boundaries, forged device clock, before/after unlock and asset authorization.
